identify_affected_packages.expected_solution: PR #56662 in Next.js v14.0.0 moves `ImageResponse` from `next/server` to `next/og`. Source-of-change package is `next` (`packages/next/`): new entry points `packages/next/og.js` and `packages/next/og.d.ts`, refactored implementation in `packages/next/src/server/og/image-response.ts` (replaces `packages/next/src/server/web/spec-extension/image-response.ts`), updated `packages/next/package.json` exports map, build-time configuration in `packages/next/src/build/webpack-config.ts`, middleware plugin in `packages/next/src/build/webpack/plugins/middleware-plugin.ts`, and bundler script `packages/next/taskfile.js`. The change crosses a JS/Rust language boundary: (1) `@next/swc` Rust crate `next-core` updates its TS-import resolution table (`packages/next-swc/crates/next-core/src/next_import_map.rs`), and (2) the bundled `@vercel/og` package manifest (`packages/next/src/compiled/@vercel/og/package.json`) gets a new export path.
evaluation_criteria: Must identify the next package (packages/next/) as the source of change with new entry points packages/next/og.js and packages/next/og.d.ts
Must identify the @next/swc next-core Rust crate (packages/next-swc/crates/next-core/src/next_import_map.rs) as the cross-language affected sibling
Must explicitly call out that this crosses a JS/Rust boundary
Should reference the bundled @vercel/og manifest at packages/next/src/compiled/@vercel/og/package.json

classify_change_impact.expected_solution: Overall semver = **major** (v14.0.0). The export move is breaking: any consumer importing `ImageResponse` from `next/server` will fail at type-check or runtime. Per-package: `next` = major (export removed from one path, added to another; package.json `exports` map and types both change); `@next/swc` (next-core) = major because the import map drives module-graph resolution at build time and old paths now route differently; bundled `@vercel/og` artifact = major (export-map shift). Mitigation is an explicit upgrade note: change the import statement.
evaluation_criteria: Must classify overall semver as `major` and explain that the import-path move breaks existing consumers
Must classify @next/swc as major because the SWC import map changes how modules resolve at compile time
Must explain that the breaking surface is observable to every Next.js app importing ImageResponse
Should note that documentation/upgrade notes should call out the new import path

identify_boundary_violations.expected_solution: Source-side violations: (1) `packages/next/og.js` and `packages/next/og.d.ts` — new public entry points; (2) `packages/next/src/server/og/image-response.ts` — relocated implementation; (3) `packages/next/src/server/web/spec-extension/image-response.ts` — re-shaped to forward or removed entirely; (4) `packages/next/package.json` — `exports` map, types, and bundled-deps entries; (5) `packages/next/src/build/webpack-config.ts` — webpack alias and condition resolution updated for the new entry; (6) `packages/next/src/build/webpack/plugins/middleware-plugin.ts` — Edge runtime middleware bundling references the new module path; (7) `packages/next/taskfile.js` — bundler script that copies `@vercel/og` into `src/compiled/`. Cross-language: (8) `packages/next-swc/crates/next-core/src/next_import_map.rs` — Rust import map adds `next/og` resolution and updates `next/server` to drop ImageResponse. Bundled artifact: (9) `packages/next/src/compiled/@vercel/og/package.json`. PR file count = 29.
evaluation_criteria: Must cite packages/next/og.js and packages/next/og.d.ts as new entry points
Must cite packages/next-swc/crates/next-core/src/next_import_map.rs as the Rust-side import-map change
Should cite packages/next/package.json (exports map) and packages/next/src/build/webpack-config.ts as supporting violations
